dimensions.evidenceA: Moses places his exclusion beside the people’s Kadesh refusal.
dimensions.evidenceB: Numbers states the exclusion after Moses’ action at Meribah.
dimensions.label: Stated cause and narrative placement

evidence.observation: Inside the spies-and-refusal retelling, Moses says the LORD was angry with him for the people’s sake and that he would not enter.
After Moses strikes the rock, the LORD says Moses and Aaron did not believe or sanctify him and therefore will not bring the assembly into the land.

record.tension: Deuteronomy and Numbers attach Moses’ non-entry to different narrative moments and stated relations without explaining the difference.
record.title: Why is Moses kept from entering the land?
